```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4)
```

```{r}
library(udfixture)
```

Estimates are computed and kept:

```{r estimate}
est <- estimate()
```

```{r report}
report(3)
```

```{r draw, fig.width = 6}
draw()
```

Data shipped next to the vignette:

```{r data}
tab <- read.csv("values.csv")
```

An error the vignette shows on purpose:

```{r expected, error = TRUE}
check_input("a") + 1
```

This chunk is shown but not run:

```{r later, eval = FALSE}
old_failure()
```

```{r conditional, eval = exists("never_defined")}
stop("this chunk must not run")
```
